thesis: The strongest short thesis is not fraud or leverage; it is peak economics. APP is valued as if Axon's extraordinary performance advantage and 80%+ EBITDA margins persist while it expands beyond gaming. Apple/Google policy changes, privacy regulation or better models from Meta/Google/Amazon could compress targeting advantage and margins simultaneously. A large drawdown can occur even with positive FCF. Current primary evidence, however, does not establish accounting impairment, financing dependence, subsidy-driven demand, moat shrinkage or fatal customer concentration.

evidence.claim: FY2025 revenue grew 70% and adjusted EBITDA margin reached 82.3%; H1 2026 margin reached 84.2%, setting an unusually high profitability baseline that can normalize.
Apple and Google possess significant discretion over distribution, identifiers and data access in the mobile ecosystem.
Controlled-company governance concentrates about 67% of voting power with voting-agreement parties as of 2025 year-end.
Against the short thesis, FY2025 FCF was $3.952B, H1 2026 FCF $2.150B and net shares declined.
No individual customer represented 10% or more of FY2025 revenue.
Locked DCF is $166.86 Bear / $429.37 Base / $771.95 Bull versus $321.49.
evidence.value: Material Bear downside despite Base discount

counterevidence: Rapid FCF growth and low physical capex suggest genuine economic advantage rather than accounting optics.
No customer >=10% and multiple products reduce single-client fragility.
Repurchases more than offset SBC, strengthening per-share economics.
Clean Deloitte audit and effective ICFR argue against accounting-quality concerns.
unknowns: How much Axon advantage survives if privacy APIs change materially.
Normalized margin under full competitive response.
Founder succession and governance under stress.
falsifiers: FCF/share continues double-digit growth while margins remain high despite stronger competition.
E-commerce/CTV become material without meaningfully higher sales costs.
Platform/privacy changes occur but Axon performance and share gains remain intact.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Deloitte issued unqualified opinions and ICFR was effective; no current evidence indicates accounting impairment.
Multi-billion-dollar FCF, ample cash and an undrawn revolver make external capital nonessential.
Revenue has grown far faster than sales spending while margins and FCF expanded.
Observed FCF growth on low incremental physical capital shows no structural ROIC collapse.
Growth, margins and cross-vertical expansion currently indicate a widening rather than shrinking moat.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Platform-policy risk is significant, but no single customer exceeds 10%, the product suite is diversified, and no single regulation is presently fatal.

key_kpis.name: Margin / take-rate durability
key_kpis.threshold: No structural collapse after competitor/platform changes

key_kpis.name: Platform-policy sensitivity
key_kpis.threshold: No sustained conversion deterioration from privacy changes
